description: Admin UI for commission settings and center management. Creates admin center detail page at /admin/centers/[id] with commission configuration form, doctor list, and booking overview. Allows admins to set percentage or fixed commission rates per center. Depends on FEAT-002 (commission API).
steps: Create app/admin/centers/[id]/page.tsx: new dynamic route for center detail page
Implement useEffect to fetch center data from GET /api/centers?id={id} on page load
Create center info section displaying name, category, status, license number, contact details
Create commission settings form with: radio buttons for commission type (PERCENTAGE/FIXED), conditional number input for rate (0-100% with step 0.1) or fixed amount ($ with step 0.01), Save button
Implement handleSaveCommission function: POST to /api/admin/centers/commission with { centerId, commissionRate, commissionType, fixedCommissionAmount }, show success/error toast, refresh center data
Add doctors section: fetch and display list of doctors for this center from GET /api/doctors?centerId={id}, show count, names, specializations, active status
Add recent bookings section: fetch bookings for this center from GET /api/bookings with center context, display in table with reference, date, status, commission amount
Style using existing Tailwind patterns from app/admin/centers/page.tsx: rounded-xl cards, dark mode support, bg-white dark:bg-gray-800, border classes
Update app/admin/centers/page.tsx: change 'View Details' links to point to /admin/centers/[id] instead of inline handling
Test UI flow: navigate to center detail, change commission settings, verify API call succeeds, refresh and confirm settings persist, check console for errors
acceptance_criteria: npm run build compiles with no errors
Commission form displays current settings loaded from database
Changing commission type (PERCENTAGE ↔ FIXED) shows/hides appropriate input fields
Saving commission settings calls POST /api/admin/centers/commission and updates database
After save, refreshing the page shows persisted commission settings
Doctors section displays all doctors for the center with accurate counts
Recent bookings section shows bookings with commission amounts for completed bookings
UI is responsive and follows existing design patterns (colors, spacing, dark mode)
Error states handled gracefully: loading spinner, error messages if API fails
verification: Run npm run build and verify exit code 0
Start dev server: npm run dev
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/admin/centers (login as admin if needed)
Click 'View Details' on any center; verify navigation to /admin/centers/[id]
Commission form displays with current settings loaded
Change commission type from PERCENTAGE to FIXED; verify input field changes from rate (%) to amount ($)
Enter 15 for percentage rate, click Save; check browser network tab for successful POST request
Refresh page; verify commission rate still shows 15% and PERCENTAGE selected
Query database: SELECT commission_rate, commission_type FROM centers WHERE id='center-id'; confirm rate=15, type=PERCENTAGE
Check doctors section displays doctor count and names correctly
